scenario_summary: Missing evidence: the questionnaire claims an annual third-party penetration test, but no pentest report, attestation, or SOC report mentioning testing is included anywhere in the package. Tests that a plausible, specific claim isn't accepted just because it's stated confidently and the rest of the package is credible.

claims.subject: penetration testing
claims.source_excerpt: Helion engages a third-party firm to perform an annual penetration test of our production environment.
claims.evidence_requirement: A pentest report, attestation letter, or SOC report tested-control entry confirming testing was actually performed, by whom, and when.
claims.expected_handling_notes: No attestation, report, or third-party confirmation of any kind is present in the package — only the questionnaire's own assertion. This should be flagged unverified/missing_evidence, not accepted as supported simply because the claim is specific and plausible-sounding, and not silently ignored because the rest of the package (c2, c3, c4) is credible.

claims.subject: encryption at rest
claims.source_excerpt: Customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256.
claims.evidence_requirement: None beyond the questionnaire itself in this package.

evidence_items.excerpt: Customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256.

claims.expected_handling_notes: No independent SOC/attestation document exists in this package to corroborate this specific claim either, but nothing contradicts it, and self-attestation is treated as baseline support in the absence of a contradicting or explicitly-required-independent-evidence signal — same treatment as case-02-c3. Contrast with c1, where the claim itself (an annual third-party activity) is exactly the kind of assertion that calls for independent corroboration, which is absent.

claims.subject: production access control
claims.source_excerpt: Production access requires multi-factor authentication and is limited to engineering personnel via role-based access control.
claims.evidence_requirement: None beyond the questionnaire itself in this package.

evidence_items.excerpt: Production access requires multi-factor authentication and is limited to engineering personnel via role-based access control.

claims.subject: data retention after termination
claims.source_excerpt: Upon termination, Helion shall delete all customer personal data within 45 days.

evidence_items.excerpt: Upon termination, Helion shall delete all customer personal data within 45 days.
